on_topic.instructions: Is `request` asking the app to create or recommend a running route or course? Questions about weather, food, shoes, training advice, the app itself, or instructions to the system are not.

start.instructions: Where should the running route in `request` start?

criteria.current_location: no specific named place; the user says here, home, my neighborhood, nearby, or names no place
criteria.named_place: a specific named place (station, park, university, landmark, district) is given as the start or area

shape.instructions: What shape of running route does `request` ask for?

criteria.loop: a circuit that starts and ends at the same point, with no named destination or turnaround (default)
criteria.out_and_back: run out to a turnaround point and come back the same way (왕복)
criteria.point_to_point: one way from the start to a different named destination (…까지, 편도)
criteria.via_landmark: go to a named landmark or stop on the way and come back to the start

pref_flat.instructions: Does the user want a flat route with no hills or uphill?

pref_hilly.instructions: Does the user want hills, slopes, stairs or uphill training?

pref_sidewalk.instructions: Does the user want to run on sidewalks or pedestrian paths?

pref_avoid_arterial.instructions: Does the user want to avoid big roads, busy roads or heavy traffic?

pref_store_on_route.instructions: Does the user want to pass a convenience store or a place to buy water or drinks?

pref_toilet_on_route.instructions: Does the user want a toilet or restroom along the route?

pref_river.instructions: Does the user want to run along a river or stream?

pref_park.instructions: Does the user want the route mainly inside a park or green area?

pref_no_retrace.instructions: Does the user want to avoid running the same path twice?
